import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import os

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['Times New Roman', 'Times', 'DejaVu Serif'],
    'mathtext.fontset': 'stix',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.labelsize': 13,

    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
})

# Data
fisher_9class   = [0, 0.55, 0.84, 0.47, 0.35, 0.71, 2.05, 1.46, 3.20, 4.03, 10.92, 9.10, 6.53]
fisher_scrambled = [0, 0.50, 0.81, 0.50, 0.33, 0.75, 1.70, 1.27, 2.50, 3.76, 5.93, 7.37, 7.91]
fisher_jbmlm    = [1.24, 0.45, 0.85, 0.46, 0.30, 0.53, 1.53, 1.11, 1.40, 1.07, 0.93, 3.33, 2.61]
fisher_vanilla  = [0, 0.43, 0.78, 0.46, 0.29, 0.52, 1.52, 1.08, 1.47, 1.04, 0.73, 2.28, 2.83]

pr_9class  = [1.0, 1.11, 5.74, 3.53, 3.21, 9.00, 3.93, 6.57, 3.36, 2.88, 1.47, 1.78, 2.02]
pr_vanilla = [1.0, 1.11, 5.00, 3.58, 3.26, 9.87, 3.76, 7.41, 3.85, 6.68, 9.70, 1.50, 1.36]

colors = {
    '9-class':   '#2ca02c',
    'scrambled': '#a8d08d',
    'JB-MLM':    '#ff7f0e',
    'vanilla':   '#1f77b4',
}
markers = {
    '9-class':   'o',
    'scrambled': 's',
    'JB-MLM':    '^',
    'vanilla':   'D',
}

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4.5))

# --- Shaded regions (both panels) ---
for ax in [ax1, ax2]:
    ax.axvspan(-0.5, 7.5, alpha=0.07, color='#888888', zorder=0)
    ax.axvspan(7.5, 12.5, alpha=0.10, color='#b8cce4', zorder=0)

# --- Left panel: Participation Ratio ---
ax1.plot(layers, pr_9class, color=colors['9-class'], marker=markers['9-class'],
         linewidth=2, markersize=6, label='9-class', zorder=3)
ax1.plot(layers, pr_vanilla, color=colors['vanilla'], marker=markers['vanilla'],
         linewidth=2, markersize=5, label='vanilla', zorder=3)

ax1.set_xlabel('Layer')
ax1.set_ylabel('Participation Ratio')
ax1.set_title('(a) Participation Ratio', fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.set_xticks(layers)
ax1.set_xlim(-0.5, 12.5)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
ax1.legend(loc='upper left', framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#cccccc')

# Region labels on PR panel
ax1.text(3.5, ax1.get_ylim()[1] * 0.03 + max(pr_9class) * 0.92, 'Early layers\n(label-independent)',
         ha='center', va='top', fontsize=8.5, color='#666666', style='italic')
ax1.text(10, ax1.get_ylim()[1] * 0.03 + max(pr_9class) * 0.92, 'Late layers\n(classification-specific)',
         ha='center', va='top', fontsize=8.5, color='#4472a8', style='italic')

# --- Right panel: Fisher Ratio (LINEAR scale) ---
ax2.plot(layers, fisher_9class, color=colors['9-class'], marker=markers['9-class'],
         linewidth=2, markersize=6, label='9-class', zorder=3)
ax2.plot(layers, fisher_scrambled, color=colors['scrambled'], marker=markers['scrambled'],
         linewidth=2, markersize=5, label='scrambled', zorder=3)
ax2.plot(layers, fisher_jbmlm, color=colors['JB-MLM'], marker=markers['JB-MLM'],
         linewidth=2, markersize=5, label='JB-MLM', zorder=3)
ax2.plot(layers, fisher_vanilla, color=colors['vanilla'], marker=markers['vanilla'],
         linewidth=2, markersize=5, label='vanilla', zorder=3)

ax2.set_xlabel('Layer')
ax2.set_ylabel('Fisher Ratio')
ax2.set_title('(b) Fisher Ratio', fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.set_xticks(layers)
ax2.set_xlim(-0.5, 12.5)
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
ax2.legend(loc='upper left', framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#cccccc')

# Annotation: spike at layer 10
ratio_10 = fisher_9class[10] / fisher_vanilla[10]
ax2.annotate(
    f'{ratio_10:.0f}× vanilla',
    xy=(10, fisher_9class[10]),
    xytext=(10.8, fisher_9class[10] + 1.2),
    fontsize=9.5, fontweight='bold', color='#2ca02c',
    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#2ca02c', lw=1.5),
    ha='center', va='bottom',
    bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', facecolor='white', edgecolor='#2ca02c', alpha=0.85),
)

# Region labels on Fisher panel
ax2.text(3.5, max(fisher_9class) * 0.95, 'Early layers\n(label-independent)',
         ha='center', va='top', fontsize=8.5, color='#666666', style='italic')
ax2.text(10, max(fisher_9class) * 0.95, 'Late layers\n(classification-specific)',
         ha='center', va='top', fontsize=8.5, color='#4472a8', style='italic')

plt.tight_layout(w_pad=3)

outdir = '/root/persuasion_turn_jailbreak_detect/figures/paper'
os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
fig.savefig(f'{outdir}/fig_layerwise_representation.pdf', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=300)
fig.savefig(f'{outdir}/fig_layerwise_representation.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=300)
print(f'Saved to {outdir}/fig_layerwise_representation.pdf and .png')
